inspection_summary: Inspected all 573 lines. The survey presents equivalent RH closure and totality statements in four unitarily related representations: a weighted sequence space, Hardy space on the critical half-plane, L2(0,1] fractional-part functions, and a piecewise-constant subspace. Its central mechanism is approximate inversion of zeta by Möbius partial sums, while semigroup invariance upgrades approximation of one vector to totality.
